feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Jury convicts a man of first-degree murder for the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur
entry.summary: A jury found Duane "Keffe D" Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 killing of rap icon Tupac Shakur, finally bringing a measure of resolution to a case that had gripped hip-hop fans for decades.

entry.title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down, White House says
entry.summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is stepping down after 18 months on the job, the White House said Monday, in the latest departure of a top military leader during the Trump administration.

entry.title: Nearly 200 witnesses to Charlie Kirk shooting apply for victims' benefits in Utah
entry.summary: While the high-profile shooting at Utah Valley University had only one homicide victim, Kirk's assassination was witnessed by thousands in person and even more as video spread online.

entry.title: Trump officials cut political interference ban after unusual Census Bureau report
entry.summary: After the Census Bureau issued a report tied to a Trump-aligned think tank, the bureau's parent agency cut language banning political interference from its scientific integrity policy, NPR learned.

entry.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
entry.summary: The highly regarded FEWS NET network stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- then says it will start posting again in September. What's the reason for this back-and-forth?

entry.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
entry.summary: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

entry.title: The U.S. sues Amazon again
entry.summary: Federal regulators and 22 states allege that the tech giant made billions by manipulating how much brands and sellers paid for ads on its platform.

entry.title: Former Congressman George Santos has been banned from Kalshi for life
entry.summary: Former Congressman George Santos has been banned from the prediction market site Kalshi for life. The betting site announced several enforcement actions against suspected insider traders.

entry.title: Paperwork, lines, hours on hold: There's a 'Time Tax' on Americans who need help most
entry.summary: Annie Lowrey explores the administrative burdens people face applying for government benefits. It's not just about wasted time: "When the government treats us like this, we don't trust it," she says.

entry.title: Lionel Messi says he's retiring from playing internationally for Argentina
entry.summary: The soccer star is ending 21 years of Argentine national-team duty but will continue to play at club level with Inter Miami in U.S. Major League Soccer.
